title: Assembling, Breaking, and Refusing the Mask: Agency in AI-Mediated Self-Presentation in Livestreaming
summary: Our mixed-method study examines how Chinese women livestreamers use masking to construct idealized mediated personas while navigating gendered, commercial, organizational, and platform pressures alongside personal agendas. We built on the concept of masking, analyzed 627 recruitment posts, and conducted livestream observations and interviews with 26 Chinese women streamers. We found that streamers assembled masks across bodies, AI-mediated technologies, spaces, performances, and social relations
